name: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky
hook: The Russian melodist of Swan Lake, The Nutcracker and the 1812 Overture.

facts.label: Swan Lake
facts.statement: In Swan Lake, the same ballerina traditionally dances both Odette and Odile, and Rothbart is the villain.

facts.label: The Nutcracker
facts.statement: The Nutcracker, based on an E.T.A. Hoffmann tale, opens with a Miniature Overture and used the then-new celesta.

facts.label: Sleeping Beauty
facts.statement: Sleeping Beauty premiered in 1890, and its wedding scene includes Little Red Riding Hood and the Big Bad Wolf.

facts.label: the 1812 Overture
facts.statement: The 1812 Overture depicts Napoleon's retreat from Moscow and quotes "La Marseillaise."

facts.label: Eugene Onegin
facts.statement: Eugene Onegin is an opera based on Pushkin's 1833 novel in verse, in which Tatyana falls for the title character.

facts.label: Carnegie Hall
facts.statement: Tchaikovsky guest conducted the opening concert of Carnegie Hall in May 1891.

facts.label: Van Cliburn
facts.statement: Van Cliburn became an American hero in 1958 by winning the International Tchaikovsky Competition and got the first ticker-tape parade for a classical musician.
